d: Single mom Sony and her teen daughters envision a home that’s for the girls; feminine, beautiful, bright and modern. Without a clue of how to make it happen, they’re trusting Nicole and Caffery to get it Styled!

Lauren’s childhood home needs big help to become the grown up family home for her, Kyle and their two boys. While real estate agent Odane needs expert staging to help his clients sell high, and buy their dream home.
Mohit and Kiru need Nicole and Caffery to bring a ‘styled’ look to their very empty new home, and Andrea’s trusting her first listing to these staging masters.
Chrissy’s multi-purpose home needs help to be as vibrant as Chrissy and her podcast with Marie, while Raymond has a house to sell that needs staging in a hurry.

Kevin, Aaron, and their three preteens love their new home, but not the all-beige design. Without free time, or any idea of how to start, they’re trusting Nicole and Caffery to bring the colour and style!
Ashley and Colin can’t wait to see how Nicole and Caffery transform Ashely’s grandmother’s dated bungalow into their new, modern, family home.

After going way over time and budget renovating the main floor of their century home, Jake and Lorraine have run out of steam and need Nicole and Caffery to take on the second floor before their fast-approaching wedding!
Electrical issues are no joke and that’s just the tip of the iceberg for Niamh and Doug’s unfinished renovation.
Sebastian and Samantha transform Joyal and Eugene’s large but dated home from pallid to palatial.
An older home with loads of problems has left Catherine and Dan with a tiny budget to renovate their narrow galley kitchen.
With a new baby on the way, Maricris and Francis have only six weeks to recreate their colourless main floor.
Joel and Kera have two growing boys, a busy schedule, and a basement straight out of the 70s. Kera’s grandmother used to own the house, but now it’s Kera and Joel’s.
Raj and Riva have a large family kitchen. But after 11 years, the brown cabinets, laminate counters and lack of organization, have them pushing the reno button.
Jenn and Phil are in DIY SOS! With Phil’s unfinished renovations, a family of raccoons in the chimney, and exterior doors that do not retain heat in the cold, the couple are getting desperate.

Maria and Alex have a bathroom that is stuck in the ‘80s, with unfashionable tile, a broken jacuzzi and a bidet. Maria is a professional makeup artist and needs an environment she can work in and be proud of.
Sarah and her husband Alex, purchase a dated Bed and Breakfast in Whistler, BC, in the hopes of transforming it into a luxury vacation rental by ski season.

The transformation of Haus Heidi into a luxury nightly vacation rental continues, as Sarah Richardson, her husband, Alex, and their construction team in Whistler, overhaul the remaining rooms on the first floor.

Sarah’s cross-country renovation journey with her husband, Alex, continues as they renovate their newly purchased B and B in Whistler, British Columbia. They sign on the dotted line for a big-ticket window and door order

Sarah and her husband, Alex, battle Mother Nature as they continue the renovation by creating a luxurious bedroom and ensuite inspired by the mountains, as well as a third-floor lounge that showcases the vistas.
While they work on their new kitchen and powder room, they’re forced to take drastic measures to 'shrink-wrap' the entire house to keep the reno going as winter rolls around.

Sarah and Alex transform the last two bedrooms of their Whistler vacation rental, but face unexpected challenges when design elements arrive damaged. Then Contractor Nathan gets stuck in Mexico after his vacation.

As Sarah and Alex’s renovation project continues to go over time and over budget, they fully gut the second floor living, dining and entertainment spaces and transform this hodgepodge of dated rooms into an open-concept.

Their backyard reno vision is not met with approval from the municipality’s permit department, so a full redesign amid the rain, sleet, and snow poses serious challenges to the already-delayed schedule.
